name: MongoDB Atlas
description: Developer/data platform: managed MongoDB cloud database with an Administration REST API for managing clusters, projects, users and backups.
access_notes: Free-forever M0 clusters and self-serve signup; service accounts (OAuth2 client credentials, recommended) and legacy HTTP Digest API keys are both created self-serve from the Atlas UI.
mcp_notes: Official MongoDB MCP Server with two first-party deployment types: self-run Local MCP and the hosted MongoDB Atlas Managed MCP Server. No Composio MongoDB/Atlas toolkit found in the Composio toolkit catalog (only an open tool-request issue ComposioHQ/composio#2984); none_found refers to the Composio toolkit specifically.
uncertainty_notes: API keys use HTTP Digest (not Basic/Bearer) and are labeled legacy. The older Atlas Data API for document CRUD was deprecated, so data-plane access is via drivers or the MCP server rather than plain REST. Webhooks refer to Atlas alert third-party/webhook notification integrations configured per project.

evidence.note: 'The Atlas Administration API accepts... Service account access tokens (OAuth 2.0)' via client-credentials flow and 'API keys (HTTP Digest Authentication)' described as legacy.

Admin API v2 reference: OAuth2 token endpoint POST https://cloud.mongodb.com/api/oauth/token returning a Bearer token; REST resources cover all Atlas components including third-party/webhook alert integrations.
Self-serve procedure for creating service accounts and API keys directly in the Atlas UI to grant programmatic access.
'The MongoDB MCP Server is our official MCP server implementation' with Local MCP and the hosted MongoDB Atlas Managed MCP Server deployment types.
